pages.title: Sampleville
pages.extract:
Sampleville is a fictional lakeside town used for testing.

== Understand ==
Sampleville grew around its old harbour.

=== Climate ===
Summers are mild and winters are wet.

== Get in ==
=== By plane ===
Sampleville Airport has daily flights from the capital. A shuttle bus runs to the harbour every 30 minutes.

=== By train ===
Trains stop at Central Station.

== Get around ==
The town is small enough to walk.

== See ==
The lighthouse on the north pier is the town's best-known sight. The harbour museum shows old fishing boats.

== Do ==
Kayak rentals operate from the east beach in summer.

== Eat ==
Grilled fish stalls line the harbour front.

== Sleep ==
=== Budget ===
The Harbour Hostel has dorm beds near the station.

=== Splurge ===
The Lighthouse Hotel has rooms with lake views.

== Connect ==
Free wifi is available in the library.

== Go next ==
